title: ChatGPT Ads Just Went Public
summary: ChatGPT Ads just opened to all US businesses at ads.openai.com. Here's what launched, what it changes for marketers, and how Gauge gives you visibility into the new ad surface from day one.
body_markdown:
ChatGPT Ads just opened to the public. Any US business can now run paid placements inside ChatGPT directly at[ads.openai.com](http://ads.openai.com/) , without an agency or a minimum spend.


#### What's live:


• Two bidding models: cost-per-impression and cost-per-click


• Ads appear below ChatGPT answers, matched to the intent of the conversation


• Conversion tracking and pixel-based measurement are part of the launch


• Free and Go tier users see ads. Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise remain ad-free


• OpenAI states the ads do not influence ChatGPT's answers and that conversations remain private from advertisers


This opens a new paid surface inside one of the largest AI platforms in the world: 2 billion queries per month, with the first ad placements any business can buy inside generative AI answers.


#### For marketers, that creates two questions overnight:


• Are competitors already bidding on the prompts your buyers run inside ChatGPT?[Gauge's ChatGPT Ads feature](https://www.withgauge.com/features/chatgpt-ads) shows you.


• Is your own[ChatGPT Ads spend](https://www.withgauge.com/blog/chatgpt-ads-what-to-track-gauge-mcp) performing across the queries that actually matter to you?


‍


#### Gauge has a dedicated ChatGPT Ads feature built for both:


• Every advertiser running ads against[the prompts you're already tracking](https://www.withgauge.com/features/prompt-tracking) , including the ad copy and the exact prompts each ad appeared against


• Whether you appear organically in those same answers, so you can tell where competitors are bidding into queries you already own and where they're breaking into ones you don't


• Your own campaign data when you[link your OpenAI Ads API key](https://docs.withgauge.com/navigating/chatgpt-ads) : budget, spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, with drill-down from campaign to ad group to individual ad to the prompts each ad ran against


• Analysis through[Ask Gauge](https://www.withgauge.com/features/ask-gauge) , the AI marketing co-pilot inside the platform, sitting next to your AI visibility, citation, and SEO data


‍


Live now at[withgauge.com](http://withgauge.com/) .
